row.name: warehouses_org_default_uq
row.where: organization_id IS NOT NULL AND is_default AND deleted_at IS NULL

row.name: warehouses_global_default_uq
row.where: organization_id IS NULL AND is_default AND deleted_at IS NULL

row.name: serial_tracked_items_warranty_check
row.value: warranty_expires_on IS NULL OR acquired_on IS NULL OR warranty_expires_on >= acquired_on

row.name: stock_adjustments_approval_check
row.value: (status NOT IN ('approved', 'posted') OR (approved_by IS NOT NULL AND approved_at IS NOT NULL))

row.name: stock_movements_transfer_target_check
row.value: (movement_type IN ('transfer_in', 'transfer_out') AND target_warehouse_id IS NOT NULL) OR (movement_type NOT IN ('transfer_in', 'transfer_out'))

row.name: stock_movements_borrowing_reference_check
row.value: (movement_type IN ('borrowing_out', 'borrowing_in') AND reference_type = 'borrowing') OR (movement_type NOT IN ('borrowing_out', 'borrowing_in'))
